description_compelling: Two or more states sign a deal cutting tariff or non-tariff barriers — bilateral FTAs, accession to regional blocs, sector-specific pacts. Trade openness, FDI flows, and regulatory-quality scores usually trend up first. Frequent in middle-income exporters anchoring credibility, and in regional integration projects deepening over time.
